```yaml
name: Codex Review - Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [ opened, synchronize, reopened ]

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Get code owner
        id: get_owner
        run: |
          # Extract the first author from the commit history
          AUTHOR=$(git log --format='%ae' -n 1 | cut -d'@' -f1)
          echo "author=$AUTHOR" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Notify code owner
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
            const prNumber = context.payload.pull_request.number;
            const author = process.env.author;

            // Create comment on PR
            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              owner: owner,
              repo: repo,
              issue_number: prNumber,
              body: `@${author} This PR updates the agent instruction layer. Please review the changes to ensure alignment with Next 16.x and MCP specifications. Key changes include:\n\n- Updated source-of-truth ordering in AGENTS.md\n- Strengthened Nia workflow guidance\n- Documented Next.js devtools and TanStack MCP from root .mcp.json\n- Corrected Next.js version and skill paths\n- Added Copilot entrypoint\n- Added Cursor-specific files (cursor.md, .cursor/rules/next-devtools-mcp.mdc)\n- Fixed -y flag in tanstack commands in both .mcp.json and .cursor/mcp.json\n\nPlease verify that the Next.js version in AGENTS.md is consistent with the repo's current version (16.2.1).`
            });
```
